premise.claim: The Curvine ThinRuntime addon points at an image and build files that no longer exist: fluid-cloudnative/curvine-thinruntime:v1.0.0 can't be pulled, and CurvineIO/curvine#571 removed build-image.sh and fluid-config-parse.py. Since CurvineIO/curvine#1078 the Fluid scripts ship in ghcr.io/curvineio/curvine.
premise.evidence: scripts/premise-check.sh: Docker Hub old image -> HTTP 404; ghcr.io/curvineio/curvine has 'latest' + release tags; upstream thin-runtime dir contains only curvine-thinruntime.yaml; Dockerfile_rocky9 installs /fluid-entrypoint.sh and /app/curvine/config-parse.py; entrypoint.sh execs /fluid-entrypoint.sh for fluid-thin-runtime; upstream example matches the PR's command/args; make docker-build exists. See results/premise-check.txt.

findings.note: Acceptance contract: the shipped addons/curvine/runtime-profile.yaml parses as a valid ThinRuntimeProfile with image ghcr.io/curvineio/curvine, tag latest, command [/entrypoint.sh], args [fluid-thin-runtime].
Acceptance contract: ThinEngine.transformFuse honors the profile's fuse image/imageTag/imagePullPolicy/command/args (the mechanism the example relies on).

liveNote: L3 skipped by round policy (no KUBECONFIG layer).
